steps.name: A Relic Awaiting Its Time (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Minuet] in "Adrica", then find [Geis] in the "Burning City".

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I thought you were busy. You're back sooner than expected. Is... something wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was passing by and came to check on you. Is everything all right?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, nothing unusual. Though I'm a little bored. Something fun would be nice.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: After all, this body can't leave this place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bored and wanting something fun... I've heard that before. Has Shynic been here?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Only you can see me. Shynic wouldn't go out of her way to visit me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Goddess Gaia probably appeared to Shynic in another form. She cannot maintain a single form for long...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Instead, she manifests in different guises. Appearing as Harmonia, Spirit King of Harmony and Stability, was probably...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that time.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Come to think of it, Goddess Gaia seems to have left a message with the Spirit King of Obedience and Covenant.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Would you visit?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... What could it be? Do you know, Minuet?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I don't know anything!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Still, I've told you everything I do know. I may be the goddess's incarnation, but I don't know everything she does...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: If there's anything new when you visit, I'll tell you. Perhaps even things about this world Goddess Iris doesn't know...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Things even Iris doesn't know...?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Oh, did I say that? I don't quite remember...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you pretend not to remember when it's inconvenient? Anyway, it doesn't seem urgent. I'll go to Geis, as you said.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes. The Spirit King of Obedience and Covenant will be waiting.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I sensed an alien power entering the Inner World. So it was you.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Your power has changed in such a short time... Typical of you, perhaps. In any case, I've been waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet said Goddess Gaia left a message.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Then let us begin. Do you know the Age of Twilight?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not really. Should I think of it as the age of the gods?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Yes. An age when many gods coexisted beyond time and space, before the Demon King Beast appeared.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: It was turbulent even then. Many demons tempted living beings to defy the gods. Enraged, the gods sought to annihilate them.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: But one god objected, and the plan was abandoned. They were exiled instead, to what is now called the Demon Realm.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Those demons revered and worshipped the Twisted Ones as gods, stealing much of what could be called the gods' legacy.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: In the resulting conflicts among gods, spirits, and demons, many relics were damaged or disappeared.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: A few passed into the hands of righteous humans and elves, where they were kept safe...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Others were sought for evil purposes, like the Staff of Destruction and Book of Shadows you learned of long ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Discover which relic those with ill intentions will target next.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I only need to identify it?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Yes. Learn which relic must be protected. When the time comes, it will guide you to itself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Where should I begin...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Belpha Library and its librarians suddenly appear faintly in your mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The library...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: That is where you must go. Follow where you are guided.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

steps.name: A Relic Awaiting Its Time (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Evil Order] in the "Frozen World" and obtain <Divine Artifact Vol. 1>. Then report to Pel in the "Belfa Library".

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Welcome... Pel just said we should wait for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, how did you... Right. Pel has a remarkable intuition.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I suddenly felt you would come. What brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Books about the Age of Twilight and its relics.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I see. We'll find them for you. Very few books on those relics remain, so I remember them clearly.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Relics of the gods...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Oh, Liz. Could that be the book that went missing recently?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Missing?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I'm afraid someone from the Alliance of Light in Lumen borrowed several books recently, including one on that subject.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: They said a spirit carried it off. It probably reacted to the mana left in the book.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: We traced the spirit to a place called the Inner World. Its deepest part, in fact.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, the 'Frozen World'...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: You know it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I've been there.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: We'd like to go ourselves, but only exceptional beings can enter...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Please help...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go. I need the book, after all...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Once you find it, bring it to us... Since a spirit reacted to it and carried it away, it must undergo a purification ritual...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: And... Oh, already gone. I still had something to say.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Ah, I meant to mention that a spirit took another book, too...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: It can't be helped. We'll tell them when they return.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: You're back... Did you find the book?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. It was a little difficult again.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Adventurer, I'm so sorry. What should we do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Is there a problem?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Well, before you left, we meant to say another book was missing...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! No wonder this one says Volume One. That means there's a Volume Two... Don't tell me it's missing, too?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Yes, it is...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: The spirit carrying off the book reacted to its remaining mana and took another one as well.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Sigh... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Neither of you needs to apologize. We can't blame a spirit for reacting to mana.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: You look rather inconvenienced...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, was it that obvious? Where did it take the book? Do you know?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Of course...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: At least it seems nearby. Monster Tree Mountain, in Mirgandia...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: But... We don't know where on the mountain...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know someone who might help. With that help, it could be surprisingly quick.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: ...The elderly spirit, I suppose.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know him?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: We've never met, but we've heard of him. He's watched over Mirgandia from there for a very long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He has quite a distinctive way of speaking.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: According to ancient records... Special spirits who have lived since ancient times speak in that manner...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I remember another spirit who talks like that...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll find the book. Anything else before I leave?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: That's everything this time. Bring it back, and we'll decipher both volumes immediately.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: ...I've said everything, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This feels a lot like deciphering the Book of Champions...)

steps.name: A Relic Awaiting Its Time (5)
steps.objective: Defeat [Arborum] in the "Monster Tree Mountain Valley" and obtain <Divine Artifact Vol. 2>. Then find [Pel] in the "Belfa Library".

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: You're here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Lapidem.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: What is it? If you've come, there must be something serious. I'm curious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain that a spirit seems to have carried a book borrowed from Belpha Library to Monster Tree Mountain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's how it happened. And the book concerns relics of the gods...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Ah, I see. No telling which villain will take which relic next, so Goddess Gaia sent you to investigate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Do you know where the book is? I thought you might.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I do, but... First, I'm sorry. It's all my fault...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I was a little bored. Asked the little spirits to bring me something interesting. Of all things, they took a book someone was reading.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It must've looked interesting to them. It had mana in it, too...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: But, well... I don't have the book.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me that little spirit...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The mana seems to have knocked it unconscious on the way... The little one's all right now, somehow. But I don't know where the book went...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Only that it fell deep into the valley.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped. I'll find it.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Sorry. I'll give you a little earth power to help you find the relic more easily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. And don't worry about the book. The spirit didn't do it on purpose, y'know... I mean, it wasn't deliberate!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Much obliged. And when you've found it, give my apologies to Lady Leda's priestesses, too. Understood?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sure will... I mean, I will!

steps.name: A Relic Awaiting Its Time (6)
steps.objective: Sense the relic's energy deep within the "Void Sea", then go to [Geis] in the "Burning City".

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Well done.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Give me the book, and I'll purify it at once...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here it is.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Just a moment.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: (Liz opens the book, closes her eyes, and chants softly. Light appears and vanishes from a magic circle behind her.)

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Finished...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're both quick, as always.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Express delivery... I mean, quick and accurate.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I wonder which relic is waiting for you. Read it. Something should come to mind as you do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's take a look.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As you read, memories of unknown relics flow into your mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A seed swaying in the wind comes to mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wind? A seed? A seed of wind, perhaps?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Pel... Does what the adventurer said remind you of anything...?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Hmm. A seed of wind... Windy Seed. I think I've read about it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Windy Seed? What's that?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: ...Perhaps the relic you're meant to encounter... We don't know where it is or what it does.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: A revelation might tell us, though.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: In any case... You'll meet it when the time comes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel a breeze coming from somewhere...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Wind... Perhaps the relic is calling you. Follow the direction of the breeze. You might learn something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Thank you, Pel, Liz.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Well done. I hope we'll see you again.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Farewell...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where should I go, then...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A wind blows from somewhere, seeming to guide you deeper into the Void Sea.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Over there?
(Where %s stops, the wind stops, too.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here...? The wind stopped here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like a path leading somewhere. But where...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Xerenis Hill... The path to Xerenis Magic Academy?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The place Jubil mentioned?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This feels strange.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I shouldn't go now, should I? I'll ask Geis first. Maybe he'll know.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: You surprise me each time you enter this world. You seem to have worked hard in a short time... Well done.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm back.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Have you identified the relic that awaits you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I saw a seed swaying in the wind. The Belpha librarians called it the 'Windy Seed.'

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I've heard the name 'Seed of Wind,' too. But I don't know its purpose or appearance.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Even a Spirit King knows little of events in the outside world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A breeze seemed to guide me somewhere. You said to wait, so perhaps I'll go there someday?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Yes. Wait. What was the name of the place the wind led you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Xerenis Hill. The path to Xerenis Magic Academy.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Xerenis... The name of a great mage.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: You can feel the relic's power, so you'll meet it when the time is right. But it may be dangerous. Be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. See you later, Geis.
